zoe: heads-up — seeing intermittent loss of X-Request-ID in the Python FastAPI sampleapp when the auth refresh path kicks in. spans split and logs can't be correlated. :worried:

rafa: is this only on async path/retries or all requests? any quick repro steps?

zoe: only when token refresh triggers an async retry/background refresh. repro: call /me with expired token -> auth middleware spawns a refresh task and retries the original upstream call. initial request has `x-request-id`, the retry's logs show no req id and traces are orphaned.

michael_p: what stack? uvicorn/gunicorn? httpx async client version? contextvars are what OTEL uses to propagate request/span ids in Python. spawning tasks w/o copying context can drop them.

zoe: uvicorn (workers=2) + FastAPI, httpx AsyncClient (v0.24) with retry logic. auth middleware does `asyncio.create_task(refresh_and_retry(...))` which apparently runs outside the incoming request context.

rafa: yep that matches. create_task does not automatically copy the current contextvars. two options: avoid creating a detached task inside middleware, or capture and run the context when scheduling.

michael_p: short patch suggestion: use contextvars.copy_context() to schedule the refresh, e.g.:
```py
ctx = contextvars.copy_context()
async def _refresh(req, ...):
  ...
asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task(ctx.run(_refresh, request))
```
that preserves request-level req-id and otel context for the retry.

zoe: i tried the ctx.run approach locally; req-id persists through retry. good catch. however, we also hit a header-redaction bug in the platform agent: when Authorization is redacted the redactor rewrites the header blob as a single masked string which discards other header keys (including x-request-id). so two independent reasons the req id vanished in logs: context loss + header collapse during redaction.

telemetry-bot: note: redaction rule DX-512 previously introduced header-string collapsing to make logs smaller, but it needs to preserve non-sensitive keys. filing followup.

rafa: action items: 1) sampleapp PR to propagate context into refresh tasks (and add integration test asserting req id preserved end-to-end); 2) redactor PR to mask header values per-key instead of collapsing whole header blob. both languages should get parity docs — Node already has retry interceptors, Go has client wrapper, add Python guidance.

michael_p: add CI integration that runs the oauth-refresh scenario under the telemetry harness and asserts identical `x-request-id` in initial request, retry request headers, logs, and span attributes. also add a short note in devex docs: "Python: avoid detached create_task in middleware; use contextvars.copy_context() or explicit propagation."

zoe: will open PRs for both today. i'll include a small code sample for the SDK parity guide showing the Python interceptor/wrapper pattern. will also add a runbook temp workaround: `export ENABLE_REQID_PROPAGATION=true` to enable a middleware shim until SDK templates roll out. :memo:
